question: How does true purity arise for those who perform bathing?
premises: Bathing involves the familiar sequence of purifying body and related measures.
Through that sequence one can enter inwardly without strain.
Such inward entry produces purity for those who bathe.
inference: Ritual bathing yields real purity when its outer sequence leads to effortless inward entry.
uncertainties: mātṛ in this compound is technical and may refer to measures, principles, or limiting factors; the gloss keeps it general.
plain_english: There, through the familiar sequence of purifying the body and related measures, those who bathe can enter inwardly without effort. From that, purity arises.
